versions.changelog:
Initial release of the offers skill.

- Provides a structured framework for designing, constructing, or improving offers, focusing on value, bonus stacking, guarantees, scarcity/urgency, naming, and payment structure.
- Introduces the Value Equation model as a core tool for diagnosing and raising the perceived value of offers.
- Details the six essential components of a complete offer and provides an audit/diagnostic loop for improving struggling offers.
- Includes best practices, common pitfalls to avoid, and reference links for deeper guidance on each aspect of offer creation.
- Targets services, agencies, courses, coaching, info products, high-ticket B2B, and direct-response businesses. For SaaS or tiered pricing, redirects to dedicated pricing resources.
